source_trust_policy: Wikipedia first (incl. sources Wikipedia itself cites), then domain authorities (IMDb for film), then other reputable outlets. Avoid low-trust aggregators (newsbreak, sacnilk, theurbanlist, coloradosound were all generation sources of confirmed errors). Verify article freshness for time-mutable facts; if freshness unverifiable, exclude the source. If even Wikipedia is ambiguous, drop the question.
